find ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData -name "*.dSYM" | xargs -I{} dwarfdump --uuid {}

find ~/Library/Developer/Xcode/Archives -name "*.dSYM" | xargs -I{} dwarfdump --uuid {}

atos -arch arm64 -o SampleMAUI.framework.dSYM/Contents/Resources/DWARF/SampleMAUI -l 0x100ef4000 \
